req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI documentation at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-018 requires GET /docs to return an HTTP 2xx response with Swagger UI content. FastAPI serves Swagger UI at /docs by default when the app is created with title/description/version metadata. Tests must: (1) confirm the happy path returns exactly 200 with HTML content containing Swagger UI markers (EP positive), (2) confirm a wrong method (POST /docs) returns 405 Method Not Allowed (NEG negative), and (3) confirm the boundary between /docs (valid) and a near-miss path /doc (invalid, 404) to catch constant/string mutations (BVA boundary). Additional tests assert exact Content-Type and key HTML payload tokens to kill mutations that change the route path string or response code comparisons.

tests.name: test_get_docs_returns_200_with_swagger_html
preconditions: FastAPI app is instantiated with title, description, and version metadata
Default Swagger UI is enabled (no docs_url=None override)
actions: Send GET /docs to the in-process TestClient
expected: Response body contains the string 'swagger-ui' (case-insensitive marker)
trace: R-PLAYER-018: system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs
EP: valid request to documented endpoint → 2xx with expected payload
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=True)

def test_get_docs_returns_200_with_swagger_html():
    response = client.get('/docs')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    content_type = response.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert 'text/html' in content_type
    body = response.text
    assert 'swagger-ui' in body.lower()
    assert 'python-samples-fastapi-restful' in body

tests.name: test_post_docs_returns_405_method_not_allowed
preconditions: GET /docs is the only allowed method for the Swagger UI endpoint
actions: Send POST /docs to the in-process TestClient
expected: HTTP status code is exactly 405 (Method Not Allowed)
Response is not 200 and not 2xx success
trace: R-PLAYER-018: error pathway — HTTP 4xx on client error
NEG: wrong HTTP method on /docs must not return 2xx
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_docs_returns_405_method_not_allowed():
    response = client.post('/docs')
    assert response.status_code == 405
    assert response.status_code != 200
    assert response.status_code != 201

tests.name: test_get_doc_near_miss_path_returns_404
preconditions: Only /docs is registered; /doc is not a valid route
actions: Send GET /doc (one character shorter than /docs) to the in-process TestClient
Send GET /docs/ (trailing slash variant) to the in-process TestClient
Send GET /docs to the in-process TestClient for contrast
expected: The two status codes are not equal, confirming path specificity
trace: R-PLAYER-018: boundary — /doc vs /docs distinguishes correct route string from off-by-one string mutation
BVA + string-constant mutation: catches mutations that change '/docs' to '/doc' or similar
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_get_doc_near_miss_path_returns_404():
    r_miss = client.get('/doc')
    assert r_miss.status_code == 404
    r_hit = client.get('/docs')
    assert r_hit.status_code == 200
    assert r_miss.status_code != r_hit.status_code

expected: HTTP status code is exactly 200 (HEAD mirrors GET status for same resource)
trace: R-PLAYER-018: boundary — HEAD /docs is the method boundary adjacent to GET /docs

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_get_docs_head_request_also_succeeds():

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.content == b''
    content_type = response.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert 'text/html' in content_type

tests.name: test_get_docs_delete_returns_4xx_not_2xx
preconditions: DELETE is not a valid method for /docs
actions: Send DELETE /docs to the in-process TestClient
expected: HTTP status code is in the 4xx range — specifically 405
Status code is not 200, not 201, not 204
trace: R-PLAYER-018: error pathway — HTTP 4xx on client error (wrong method)
NEG + comparison-mutation: ensures status != 200 is enforced; kills mutations that return 200 for all methods
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_get_docs_delete_returns_4xx_not_2xx():
    response = client.delete('/docs')
    assert response.status_code == 405
    assert response.status_code != 200
    assert response.status_code != 204
    assert response.status_code != 201
